source: DRAT anchor sets — supplied by the experimenter. Schapiro, Gladstone, Black & Ji (2026), arXiv:2605.13450. Each participant is assigned ONE anchor set (by slot; see core.js). The participant generates n_words nouns that are (a) maximally different from each other AND (b) each relatable — even loosely or figuratively — to the k anchor words shown. Two anchors per set: participants are asked to connect each word to both, with a clear connection to one accepted as a fallback (the scorer keeps a word if its closest anchor clears the utility threshold).
